codes.name: Unclear state and next action
codes.include: Confusion between queued, held and confirmed, or uncertainty about the next action
codes.exclude: A complaint only about not receiving email
codes.implication: State the current status, required action and consequence of inaction together

codes.name: Duplicate registration as insurance
codes.include: Registering for equivalent sessions to preserve options or avoid missing out
codes.exclude: Registering for independent events with different content
codes.implication: Collect acceptable sessions and preferences once; explain the one-seat-per-workshop rule

codes.name: Manual coordination after cancellation
codes.include: A manual chain of cancellation, contacting the next person, waiting for a reply and updating a sheet
codes.implication: Automate backfill with an explanatory log; distinguish an offer from its acceptance

codes.name: Confirmation windows and notification reach
codes.include: Classes, work or offline periods make a short hold window unsuitable
codes.exclude: The event start time itself is unsuitable
codes.implication: Allow organisers to configure holds and display the deadline clearly

codes.name: Queue fairness and explainability
codes.include: Questions about arrival order, preference matching or why another person received a seat first
codes.exclude: Personal preferences unrelated to allocation rules
codes.implication: Explain both arrival order and acceptable-session constraints; avoid promising an exact wait

codes.name: Permissions, data and procurement constraints
codes.include: Institutional systems, exports, retention, organisation permissions or budget restrictions
codes.exclude: General feature wishes without a concrete restriction
codes.implication: Provide CSV export and organisation permissions; validate pricing and procurement separately
